name: Providence Petrel
rangeDescription: Breeds lord howe island and philip island; ranges to northwestern pacific
description: Heavyset, gray-brownish seabird of the open Pacific Ocean, with pale patches in the underwings at the primary feathers and indistinct pale feathering around the bill base. Upperparts sometimes show grayish, almost silvery grizzled appearance.

name: Pink-bellied Imperial-Pigeon
rangeDescription: Highlands of philippines
description: A large pigeon of foothill and lower montane forest canopy with a white head, a dark bluish-gray chest and upper back, green wings, a whitish belly with a pink tinge, and rufous under the base of the tail. Note the large red eye-ring.

name: White-faced Ibis
rangeDescription: Great basin of western usa to southwestern brazil and central argentina
description: Long decurved bill. Dark overall with iridescent green and reddish tones on adults.

name: Black-billed Magpie
rangeDescription: Alaska and yukon to western canada and western usa
description: Large, conspicuous, black-and-white bird; related to crows and jays. Unmistakably long tail and bold pattern, especially visible in flight.

name: Red-and-black Thrush
rangeDescription: Peleng, in banggai islands, and taliabu, in sula islands (off eastern sulawesi)
description: A striking, little-known thrush with a largely jet black body except for a carmine red back, rump, and nape and a large white smudge on the cheeks. Forages on the ground singly or in pairs inside lowland forest.

name: Blue-eyed Ground Dove
rangeDescription: Cerrado of south-central brazil
description: Stunningly beautiful dove that has only recently been rediscovered. Cinnamon-colored overall but paler below.

name: Rufous-faced Antpitta
rangeDescription: Yungas of western bolivia (la paz, cochabamba, and santa cruz)
description: Medium-sized antpitta found in the Andes of Bolivia and far southeastern Peru near the border. Adult is grayish-brown with a rufous face and a white throat and belly.

name: Scarlet-chested Parrot
rangeDescription: Interior of southern australia
description: Brightly colored nomadic desert parrot with a relatively short tail, mostly found in the Great Victoria Desert, with very occasional records outside this area. Feeds on the ground in arid bushland.

name: Slate-throated Gnatcatcher
rangeDescription: Tropical forest of eastern panama to northwestern ecuador
description: Uncommon from extreme eastern Panama to northwest Ecuador. Typical gnatcatcher shape: small and long-tailed.

name: Demoiselle Crane
rangeDescription: Palearctic; winters in northeastern africa and southern asia
description: Small gray crane of open expansive habitats. Adult is an elegantly smooth shade of gray with a black neck, fiery eyes, and pure white plumes extending out from behind the eyes.

name: Bare-headed Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Highlands of northeastern borneo
description: Thickset, dark-gray-brown laughingthrush with a bright-candy-red bill, broad blue moustache patches, and a sickly-looking bare yellow crown. Endemic to the highlands of north-central Borneo.

name: Tufted Puffin
rangeDescription: Coasts and islands of northeastern asia to aleutians and southern california
description: The largest puffin, this chunky seabird has an entirely black body, white face, and fetching tuft of yellowish feathers curling around its nape. Thick orange bill and orange feet.

name: Long-billed Dowitcher
rangeDescription: Breeds siberia and alaska; winters southern usa to panama
description: Plump, medium-sized shorebird with very long bill. Extremely similar to Short-billed Dowitcher, and often flocks with it.

name: St. Helena Plover
rangeDescription: St. helena island (southern atlantic ocean)
description: A long-legged plover with a long black bill, a black eye mask and crown, and a white forehead. Upperparts brownish, and underparts whitish washed with peachy orange.

name: Fiji Woodswallow
rangeDescription: Northern fiji (yasawa and viti levu to taveuni and qamea)
description: A thick-bodied, highly aerobatic bird, white below and dark above with a dark chin and white cheek. Often perches on wires.

name: Streaked Bowerbird
rangeDescription: Southeastern papua new guinea (owen stanley mountains)
description: A fairly small bowerbird of foothill and lower montane forest. Dull brown color with some subtle streaking on the throat and breast.

name: Pied Oystercatcher
rangeDescription: Coastal australia including tasmania, and southern new guinea, aru, and kai islands
description: Heavy-set shorebird with long, thick reddish bill, black and white plumage, and thick pale-pink feet and legs. Usually coastal, but sometimes found on wetter pastures close to the coast.

name: Sangihe Golden-Bulbul
rangeDescription: Sangihe islands (off sulawesi)
description: A dull thrush-sized songbird with a long stout bill. Uniform dark olive above with a prominent yellow patch between bill and eye, a yellow throat, a dark eye, and paler cheeks.

name: White-winged Collared-Dove
rangeDescription: Borassus palm regions of southeastern ethiopia and southwestern somalia
description: A distinctive dove with a restricted range. The white wing patches are usually visible when perched, and become very conspicuous in flight.

name: Hose's Broadbill
rangeDescription: Patchily distributed submontane forest of northern and central borneo
description: Uncommon and elusive green broadbill. Both sexes distinguished from other Bornean green broadbills by blue wash on belly; it is bright ultramarine in males and paler blue in females.
